Feature: 07 Feature and rule backgrounds

Background:
    Given a logged in customer

Rule: 07 rule with its own background

    Background:
        Given the address is checked

    Example: 07 a one
        When the customer acts "a one"
        Then the outcome is "a one"

    Example: 07 a two
        When the customer acts "a two"
        Then the outcome is "a two"

Rule: 07 rule without one

    Example: 07 b one
        When the customer acts "b one"
        Then the outcome is "b one"

    Example: 07 b two
        When the customer acts "b two"
        Then the outcome is "b two"

Feature: 11 A background step that calls a step

Background:
    Given a composite step calls another

Scenario: 11 one
    When the customer acts "one"
    Then the outcome is "one"

Scenario: 11 two
    When the customer acts "two"
    Then the outcome is "two"

Feature: 16 Two files, one title

Scenario: 16 from file b
    Given a logged in customer
    Then the outcome is "b"

Feature: 16 Two files, one title

Background:
    Given a logged in customer

Scenario: 16 from file a
    Then the outcome is "a"

Feature: 13 Star keyword

Background:
    * a logged in customer

Scenario: 13 one
    * the basket holds "apple"
    Then the outcome is "one"

Scenario: 13 two
    * the basket holds "pear"
    Then the outcome is "two"

Feature: 15 Background and a scenario with no steps

Background:
    Given a logged in customer

Scenario: 15 empty

Scenario: 15 full
    When the customer acts "full"
    Then the outcome is "full"

Feature: 17 Background fails, then Then

Background:
    Given a logged in customer

Scenario: 17 holds
    Then the outcome is "holds"

@fail-bg2
Scenario: 17 breaks
    Then the outcome is "breaks"

Feature: 10 Background and an outline

Background:
    Given a logged in customer

Scenario Outline: 10 row <what>
    When the customer acts "<what>"
    Then the outcome is "<what>"

Examples:
    | what |
    | x    |
    | y    |

Feature: 05 No background, outline with placeholders in a table

Scenario Outline: 05 row <sku>
    Given the basket holds
        | sku   |
        | <sku> |
    When the customer acts "the same"
    Then the outcome is "the same"

Examples:
    | sku    |
    | APPLE  |
    | BANANA |

Feature: 04 No background, shared Given and When

Scenario: 04 one
    Given the basket holds
        | sku   |
        | APPLE |
    When the customer acts "the same"
    Then the outcome is "one"

Scenario: 04 two
    Given the basket holds
        | sku    |
        | BANANA |
    When the customer acts "the same"
    Then the outcome is "two"

Feature: 08 Background fails, then When

Background:
    Given a logged in customer

Scenario: 08 holds
    When the customer acts "holds"
    Then the outcome is "holds"

@fail-bg
Scenario: 08 breaks
    When the customer acts "breaks"
    Then the outcome is "breaks"

Feature: 18 A shared step attaches a file

Scenario: 18 one
    Given a screenshot is attached
    Then the outcome is "one"

Scenario: 18 two
    Given a screenshot is attached
    Then the outcome is "two"

Feature: 14 No background, a doc string differs

Scenario: 14 one
    Given a note says
        """
        apple
        """
    Then the outcome is "one"

Scenario: 14 two
    Given a note says
        """
        banana
        """
    Then the outcome is "two"

Feature: 03 Background then Then

Background:
    Given a logged in customer

Scenario: 03 one
    Then the outcome is "one"

Scenario: 03 two
    Then the outcome is "two"

Feature: 20 A placeholder written in a background

Background:
    Given the basket holds "<what>"

Scenario Outline: 20 row <what>
    When the customer acts "<what>"
    Then the outcome is "<what>"

Examples:
    | what |
    | x    |
    | y    |

    Given a logged in customer

Scenario: 01 one
    When the customer acts "one"
    Then the outcome is "one"

Scenario: 01 two
    When the customer acts "two"
    Then the outcome is "two"
